top_signals.title: AI Billions, Oil Swings and an Inflation Test | Open Interest 8/11/2026
top_signals.summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with David Gura and Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Open Interest." The AI money machine keeps rolling as Intel, Nvidia and Anthropic line up billions. Meanwhile, oil erases earlier gains as Pakistan signals optimism over a US-Iran deal. And an inflation test looms as investors brace for key data that could shape the Federal Reserve's next move. Plus, Peter Beck, Rocket Lab founder, president and CEO, says the company is pushing hard to launch its Neutron rocket for the first time this year. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
